+title: 'A board works in any folder: git is not required'
+---
+## What
+The owner decided that git is not required. `KanbanGraph(root:)` must open and make a board in any folder. Now `BoardKey.read(fromRepoAt:)` (`Sources/FoundationModelsKanban/Identity/BoardKey.swift:128-133`) runs `git config` and `git rev-parse`, and a folder that is not in a git repo throws `gitFailed`. A remote `origin` that is a local path (`/srv/git/repo.git`, `../upstream`, `file:///…`) throws `invalidRemoteURL` (`BoardKey.swift:49-57`, `:128-133`).
+
+- `BoardKey.read`: when the folder is not in a git repo, or git is not installed, the key is `local/<folder-name>`, where `<folder-name>` is the last path component of `root`. When `origin` has no host (a local path or `file://`), the key is `local/<main-clone-name>` (the same as a repo with no remote).
+- `.kanban/` stays at `<root>/.kanban/`. `root` is the folder that the caller gives. Do not search up for a git top-level directory.
+- `Sources/FoundationModelsKanban/CrossRepo/BoardLocator.swift:77-93` (`repos(in:)`): a directory is a candidate when it has a `.git` entry OR a `.kanban/board.jsonl` file. Thus related boards in folders that are not git repos are found.
+- Check other git uses (`rg -n "Git.run" Sources`) and make each one optional when there is no repo.
+- Update plan.md: §2.1 (`Board` = the board of one folder; a git repo is one case), §3.2, §6.6, §12 items 4, 13 and 26. Say that a folder that is not a git repo gets `local/<folder-name>`.
+
+## Acceptance Criteria
+- [ ] `KanbanGraph(root: <temp folder with no .git>)` + `addTask` makes `<root>/.kanban/` and returns a task id with the key `local/<folder-name>`.
+- [ ] A repo whose `origin` is a local path opens with the key `local/<main-clone-name>`.
+- [ ] The locator finds a related board in a sibling folder that has `.kanban/board.jsonl` and no `.git`.
+- [ ] Each existing git test still passes.
+
+## Tests
+- [ ] `Tests/FoundationModelsKanbanTests/Identity/BoardKeyTests.swift`: no repo, and a local-path `origin`.
+- [ ] `Tests/FoundationModelsKanbanTests/CrossRepo/BoardLocatorTests.swift`: a sibling board with no `.git`.
+- [ ] `Tests/FoundationModelsKanbanTests/Tool/KanbanGraphTests.swift`: open a board in a plain temp folder and run a mutation and a query.
+- [ ] `swift test` passes.
+
+## Workflow
+- Use `/tdd` — write failing tests first, then implement to make them pass.
\ No newline at end of file
